Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIITDM Kancheepuram Project Technical Support - III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post being recruited for?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Project Technical Support - III at IIITDM Kancheepuram. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Technical Support - III position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report directly to the venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Technical Support - III?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a First-class postgraduate degree, or a Second Class Post Graduate Degree with PhD, or a First Class Graduate Degree of Four Years in Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support - III?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000 per month plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Indian Institute of Information Technology Design and Manufacturing Kancheepuram, Chennai - 600127, Tamil Nadu.
